item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 11/Sep/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak and it will be very hot over Guangdong today. Showers triggered by high temperatures will also affect the region. A dry continental airstream is expected to bring very hot and fine weather to southern China this week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Muifa will intensify gradually and move across the seas east of Taiwan in the next couple of days.

Weather: Mainly cloudy. Very hot with sunny periods and some haze during the day. One or two showers later.
